subject: alt-f
title: ALT.F.------RT.DY.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-11, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the vibrationaltory lining of creative black music is the same as the composite thrust of black culture—whether African or so-called American—yet the meta-reality and science of creative black music is separate from Africa or the world group, because of the nature of the path American black people have had to take.' (C)ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is crossed with (C)RT-DY (reality dynamics) — note the *double* (c) prefix: the concept of alternative functionalism is crossed with the concept of reality dynamics. ALT-F branches to POL-ST (political state), POL-DYM (political dynamics), PRI-INFO (principle information), and PHY-U-C (physical universe context). PHY-U-C runs on to PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and branches to RT-OP (reality options); RT-OP branches to SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and dashed-links to AFN (affinity negation), and PROG-CONT dashed-links to PER-TRS (perceived transition) — a dotted line amplifies some aspect of the concept it is connected to. The argument: trans-African creativity is structurally an *alternative functionalism* crossed with reality dynamics, with the political and physical-universe layers that constrain post-slavery black expression branching from it.
